slides.title: LLMs in Asset Management

shapes.name: !!cover.title
shapes.source:
资管公司工作流程中的
LLM 应用

slides.notes: This presentation examines how LLMs can support the day-to-day work of an asset manager. It starts with peer practices, then develops proposed applications for the firm. The discussion follows front-, middle- and back-office work, using Company A and a quarterly client update as recurring examples. Cover image: an AI-generated research workspace.
slides.original_notes:
本报告围绕公司同事每天完成的工作展开，先看同行怎样使用大模型，再提出适合公司启动的应用方案。正文依次讨论前台、中台和后台，最后将七项建议汇成两条跨部门流程。
封面图片：本报告使用内置image_gen生成的办公场景概念图。

slides.title: Research scope and application goals

shapes.name: !!scope.result
shapes.source: 沿业务流程建设应用，让同事在日常任务中使用 LLM
shapes.english: Build applications around the work people need to complete

slides.notes: The inputs are documents, data, messages and business requests. LLMs interpret questions, read and compare material, organize explanations, and draft text or code. Connected tools perform queries, calculations and other operations. Employees check the results and use them to complete research, trading preparation, client communications, review and development tasks.
slides.original_notes: 报告讨论同事每天处理的文档、数据、消息和业务要求。LLM负责理解问题、阅读材料、比较和组织解释、生成文字或程序，数据查询、计算和执行操作由相应工具完成。同事核对结果并继续完成研究、交易准备、材料审核与开发工作。下面沿前台、中台和后台七项任务展开。

shapes.source: 反复检索、抄录和核对之后，才能集中判断经营变化
shapes.english: Repeated searching, extraction and checking take time away from analysis

slides.notes: The analyst needs to explain why Company A’s revenue grew and whether that growth can continue. The preparation involves locating comparable revenue and volume data, reading the explanation in meeting notes and comparing two research reports. In this illustrative scenario, prior-quarter and current-quarter revenue are RMB 100m and RMB 110m, while sales volume is 1.0m and 1.1m units. Repeated searches, extraction, calculations and rereading are the work required before the analyst can assess the business. The next three slides show peer approaches to earnings analysis, research synthesis and template preparation.
slides.original_notes: 研究员要解释甲公司本季度收入为何增长，以及增长能否持续。先在财报找到上季与本季收入、销量，再读会议中关于渠道补库的说明，最后比较两份研报的不同判断。页面数值和材料为同一演示案例：收入单位为百万元，销量单位为万件。反复找资料、抄数据、计算、重读和整理观点，构成分析之前的准备工作。随后三页分别介绍同行怎样让LLM参与财务分析、观点比较和研究表填写。

slides.notes:
Tianhong’s FinAgent breaks a net-profit question into revenue, cost of sales and expenses, then explores drivers such as volume, selling price, raw materials and distribution. The LLM organizes the questions and calls data and calculation tools. Those tools return the figures and calculations. The model connects them to operating and industry information, while the analyst assesses the quality and persistence of growth. Tianhong reported that the associated manual data preparation and calculations fell from days to minutes.

Fullgoal first uses the model to assess each report’s relevance to the investment target. It then summarizes the reports against the analyst’s research interests, synthesizes the summaries, adjusts the wording and checks the result. In the Company A example, Report A links higher volumes to a lasting demand recovery. Report B emphasizes channel restocking and questions whether it will persist. The LLM makes the common ground and competing explanations easy to compare. The analyst can investigate the disagreement with the original reports at hand.

The analyst checks the references, tests the restocking thesis and forms a view. The figures and source excerpts are illustrative.

shapes.english: Whether employees continue to use the application

slides.notes: Start with research and client communications. Compare similar tasks before and after application use, tracking completion time, output adoption, rework and repeat usage. Use the findings to identify whether the issue is missing information, an unsuitable model explanation or an awkward query or file-handling step. Continued use and reduced preparation work provide a practical basis for deciding what to improve and extend.
slides.original_notes: 从研究分析与客户材料两条流程启动，记录同一类任务使用应用前后的完成时间、结果采用情况、返工次数和持续使用频次。结合具体问题判断是资料缺失、模型解释不合适，还是查询与文件操作不顺畅，再调整相应环节。同事是否持续使用，以及结果是否减少重复准备，是后续推进的重要依据。
